description: This header file belongs to the 'Utils' namespace and contains utility functions for file operations, property reading, file content processing, path checks, recursive file searches with pattern matching, and variable expansion within strings. The functions facilitate reading properties from files, reading file contents, checking file types, recursing into directories for matching files, and expanding variables in strings based on file properties.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads the value of a specified property from a file, supporting recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches directories with pattern matching and exclusions, limiting results and depth.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive file search based on input path, depth limits, and exclusions; wraps 'searchFilesRec'.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables in a string by replacing them with property values read from a specified file.
